description: Paid: fetch a public URL and return its cited, paragraph-addressable text with integrity hashes and a receipt. Uses one prepaid credit, and only when extraction succeeds. Needs a ProofFetch key sent as the MCP request header Authorization: Bearer <key> (sold on the ProofFetch home page). Example: {"url":"https://example.com/"}.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. The same value on a retry returns the stored result without using a second credit; a call without one is a new purchase.

maxChars.description: Maximum normalized characters to extract. Free preflight returns metadata plus a preview of about the first 1,000 characters.

url.description: Public HTTP(S) document URL. No credentials, private networks, authenticated pages or browser rendering.

name: proof_fetch_evidence
title: Get cited page text (paid)
